name: Database utilities
summary: PostgreSQL and SQLite clients, pooling, migrations, transactions, health, seeding and query instrumentation.
description: Reusable database development utilities for Node.js. Provides the SqlClient port used across ASPEC modules, with PostgreSQL (pg) and SQLite (better-sqlite3 or node:sqlite) drivers, connection pooling, file and programmatic migrations with checksums and locking, transactional helpers with retries, health checks, idempotent seeding, query instrumentation and configuration validation that never leaks passwords.

capabilities.summary: SqlClient port with $1 placeholders on every dialect.
PostgreSQL connection pooling with timeouts and SSL modes.
File and programmatic migrations with checksums and locking.
Nested transactions, isolation options and retry helpers.
SELECT 1 health checks with latency and pool stats.
Idempotent seeds with a production guard.
onQuery hooks, slow query logging and optional OpenTelemetry spans.
aspec-db CLI for migrate, status, rollback, create and seed.

optional.reason: HealthCheckable results and LoggerLike are compatible with the observability module.

Portable core: createDatabase, migrations, seeding, transactions, health

requirements: pg for PostgreSQL or better-sqlite3 / node:sqlite for SQLite

required.name: DATABASE_URL
required.description: PostgreSQL or SQLite connection URL (or file path for SQLite).

optional.name: DATABASE_POOL_MAX
optional.description: PostgreSQL pool size (mapped in generated setup when used).

targets.label: Any TypeScript project

files.description: Creates the database client and a migrator from DATABASE_URL.

steps: Import { db, migrator } from the generated setup file.
Call await migrator.up() during application startup (or use the aspec-db CLI).
Pass db (SqlClient) into other ASPEC modules that need SQL storage.

targets.label: Any JavaScript project

files.description: Creates the database client and a migrator from DATABASE_URL.

steps: Import { db, migrator } from the generated setup file.
Call await migrator.up() during application startup (or use the aspec-db CLI).
Pass db into other ASPEC modules that need SQL storage.
Remove generated setup imports from application startup.
Stop using the aspec-db CLI in scripts.
Optionally drop <prefix>schema_migrations and <prefix>seeds tables if you no longer need migration history.
uninstall.dataRetention: Application tables and migration tracking tables are not dropped automatically.

notes: Passwords are redacted from configuration errors, logs and CLI output.
Query parameters are redacted from instrumentation events unless logParameters is enabled.
Use verify-full SSL with a CA in production PostgreSQL deployments.

ai.summary: Use createDatabase({ url }) or createPostgresClient / createSqliteClient for SqlClient. Run migrations with createMigrator or aspec-db CLI.
useWhen: You need a SqlClient for other ASPEC modules.
You need migrations, seeding, pooling or transaction retries for PostgreSQL or SQLite.
avoidWhen: You need a full ORM with schema modeling.
You need MySQL or another dialect (adapter boundary exists but is not implemented yet).

entrypoints.name: createDatabase
entrypoints.description: Creates a Database client from a URL or config.

entrypoints.name: aspec-db
entrypoints.description: CLI for migrate, status, rollback, create and seed.
